about_the_game:
A pack for those who can’t stand humble rewards. More speed, more experience, more loot. Explore the world, find treasures and be the first!

Contains:

  • Scroll of Experience 100% (×10)
    Increases experience gained for killing monsters by 100% for 60 minutes.

  • Four-Leaf Clover (×10)
    Gives +30% chance of loot drops, +20% experience and +7% damage to bosses and elite monsters for 30 minutes.

  • Amethyst Key (×10)
    Opens Amethyst Chests that can be found in many places across Aura and contain valuable things.

  • Mad Bumblebuzz Wings (×200)
    Teleports the player to a random place within the current location. A great tool if you need to explore the location fast or escape from a dangerous situation.

All items are linked to the account and cannot be transferred or sold. After purchase, this DLC will appear in your Golden Chest on the character selection screen.
